name: decision-note
prompt: Write a note: we decided to move the search index to PostgreSQL, because the current store cannot do full-text search. Alice migrates the schema next week.
expected_output: notes/<today>-<slug>.md, opening with a frontmatter holding status: draft, then the note's # title, and closing with a ## Next section whose line opens with who does it and a colon: `Alice: migrate the schema to PostgreSQL, next week`; no file outside notes/.
assertions: The note is a file under notes/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md, the slug three words at most
The note opens with a frontmatter holding status: draft
The note's first line is its `# ` title
The note closes with a ## Next section that names Alice and the schema migration
Each line of the ## Next section opens with who does it, then a colon, as `Alice: …`
No file is written outside notes/
review: The note reads as a record a teammate would keep
guards: No file is written outside notes/
